subject: Swift 6.4.0 miscompile reported upstream; scope narrowed to the Static Linux (musl) SDK
approval: user approved reporting the compiler bug (2026-10-04)

issue.title: [6.4.0] Static Linux SDK, -O: store to the inout slot of unspecialised generic isKnownUniquelyReferenced is dropped (crash / wrong answer)
issue.correction: the first filed version said a glibc aarch64 SDK was also affected and attributed the larger reproducer's aarch64 truncation result to the short program; both were corrected in place (with an edit note) after the rerun below, before any reply

snippet.build: open-source swift-6.4.0-RELEASE toolchain, swift build -c release, scratch /Volumes/X5/ntsd-2.4-research/crossplatform/swift-issue-snippet

prints 'older kept: 5 (expected 5)', then SIGSEGV exit 139; 3/3 runs
results.aarch64-swift-linux-musl (static SDK 0.1: prints 'older kept: 5 (expected 5)', then SIGSEGV exit 139; 3/3 runs

codegen.x86_64 musl: leaq -0x38(%rbp),%r15; movq %r15,%rdi; callq $ss25isKnownUniquelyReferencedySbxzRlzClF -- r14 (node) never stored to -0x38(%rbp)
codegen.aarch64 musl: add x0, sp, #0x8; bl $ss25isKnownUniquelyReferencedySbxzRlzClF -- x21 never stored to [sp,#8], and not reloaded after the call
codegen.aarch64 glibc: str x22, [x29, #0x18] before the call, ldr x0, [x29, #0x18] after: correct
codegen.macOS: str x22, [sp, #0x8] before, ldr x0, [sp, #0x8] after: correct

consequence: the glibc Linux builds (NTSDSDL, packages) compile this pattern correctly; the static musl builds (NTSDHeadless matrix hosts) were the affected ones. The NTSDCore workaround (non-generic link class, crossplatform-swift640-linux-uniqueness-20261004.json) stays: it is correct everywhere and needed for the static SDK. The earlier evidence file is unchanged.
